bindingResolution: read Pages production DB binding; if missing, show existing D1 IDs and sqlite_master tables; require explicit database selection; require 1=YES or 0=NO confirmation; retry invalid consent three times
singleCommandSteps: verify account and existing Pages project
match binding UUID against existing D1 list if present
if Pages has no DB binding, inspect tables of all existing D1 databases read-only
ask user to select existing D1 database
confirm separately with 1=YES or 0=NO; retry invalid answer up to three times
backup and update Wrangler DB binding with selected database UUID
apply migrations to selected existing database
deploy existing Pages project main so binding takes effect
